stem: After raising a fixture, the center PPFD decreases slightly but edge readings increase relative to the center. What is the most defensible interpretation?
choices: Distribution may have become more uniform even though peak PPFD fell
DLI must have increased at every canopy location
Spectrum necessarily changed because fixture height changed
The PPFD meter is invalid because readings moved in opposite directions
rationale: Changing fixture distance can alter spatial distribution. A lower peak together with relatively stronger edges can indicate improved uniformity, which should be verified with the full grid.
